title: Optical Density Measurement for Bacterial Solution
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vude6s6

steps.title: Prepare Cuvettes and Blank
steps.instruction: Prepare the cuvettes and the blank solution for the spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Clean disposable cuvettes with ethanol and lint-free paper
Aliquot a small amount of LB broth into a falcon tube for use as a blank
Fill approximately 1ml of the LB broth into a clean cuvette

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the bacterial stock and prepare sample cuvettes.

substeps.instruction: Mix/Vortex the tube containing the stock bacteria to achieve a homogenized solution
Take three aliquots from the same tube and place them into three different cuvettes

steps.title: Configure Spectrophotometer
steps.instruction: Initialize the device and set the required parameters.

substeps.instruction: Press the bottom left button to select the OD program

steps.title: Measure Optical Density
steps.instruction: Perform the OD600 measurements for the blank and samples.

substeps.instruction: Insert the blank cuvette and press the blank button
Insert sample cuvette 1 and press the sample button
Repeat the measurement process for the second and third samples
Calculate the average of the three sample readings

steps.title: Post-Measurement Cleanup
steps.instruction: Shut down the equipment and dispose of materials.

substeps.instruction: Close the lid to the spectrophotometer
